Setup.formula:
LET(
  weeks, E2:E11,
  null, "placeholder!@#$",
  REDUCE(null, weeks, LAMBDA(acc, week, LET(
    spaced, HSTACK(week, ""),
    IF(acc=null, spaced, HSTACK(acc, spaced))
  )))
)

IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("LET(
  table, $M$3:$V$12,
  numTeams, ROWS(table),
  weeks, TRANSPOSE(FILTER(E2:E1000, E2:E1000<>"""")),
  teams, K3:L12,
  row_start, MIN(ROW(table)),
  col_start, MIN(COLUMN(table)),
  xVals, ARRAYFORMULA(MOD(SEQUENCE(numTeams*numTeams, 1, 0), numTeams)"&"),
  yVals, SORT(xVals),
  coords, FILTER(HSTACK(yVals, xVals), xVals > yVals),
  null, ""placeholder#@$%"",
  ans, REDUCE(null, weeks, LAMBDA(acc, week, LET(
    filterForCoords, BYROW(coords, LAMBDA(coord, OFFSET($M$3, CHOOSECOLS(coord, 2), CHOOSECOLS(c"&"oord, 1))=week)),
    filteredCoords, BYROW(FILTER(coords, filterForCoords), LAMBDA(coord, TRANSPOSE(SORT(TRANSPOSE(coord), 1, MOD(SUM(coord), 2))))),
    matches, MAP(filteredCoords, LAMBDA(idx, IFERROR(INDEX(teams, idx + 1, 2), """"))),
    result, IF(C"&"OLUMNS(matches)<2, HSTACK("""", """"), matches),
    IF(acc=null, result, HSTACK(acc, result))
  ))),
  MAP(ans, LAMBDA(val, IFNA(val, """")))
)"),"Mommy Mag")

RBE League Play Standings.formula:
IFERROR(__xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION("LET(
  weeks, FILTER(Setup!E2:E14, Setup!E2:E14<>""""),
  teams, FILTER(Setup!A2:B14, Setup!B2:B14<>""""),
  firstTeam, 'RBE League Play'!C4,
  cellsToNextColumn, 4,
  cellsToNextRow, 3,
  maxMatchesPerWeek, 11,
  columnStarts, SEQUENCE(1, ROWS(weeks), 0,"&" cellsToNextColumn),
  rowStarts, SEQUENCE(1, maxMatchesPerWeek, 0, cellsToNextRow),
  temp, MAP(columnStarts, LAMBDA(colOffset, OFFSET(firstTeam, 0, colOffset, cellsToNextRow*maxMatchesPerWeek, 1))),
  initTable, HSTACK(teams, SEQUENCE(ROWS(teams), 1, 0,"&" 0), SEQUENCE(ROWS(teams), 1, 0, 0)),
  standings, REDUCE(initTable, columnStarts, LAMBDA(tableBetweenCols, colOffset, REDUCE(
    tableBetweenCols, rowStarts, LAMBDA(table, rowOffset, LET(
      team1, OFFSET(firstTeam, rowOffset, colOffset),
      team2"&", OFFSET(firstTeam, rowOffset + 1, colOffset),
      score1, OFFSET(firstTeam, rowOffset, colOffset + 1),
      score2, OFFSET(firstTeam, rowOffset + 1, colOffset + 1),
      team1PrevMD, XLOOKUP(team1, CHOOSECOLS(table, 2), CHOOSECOLS(table, 3)),
      t"&"eam1PrevGD, XLOOKUP(team1, CHOOSECOLS(table, 2), CHOOSECOLS(table, 4)),
      team2PrevMD, XLOOKUP(team2, CHOOSECOLS(table, 2), CHOOSECOLS(table, 3)),
      team2PrevGD, XLOOKUP(team2, CHOOSECOLS(table, 2), CHOOSECOLS(table, 4)),
      MDdelta, IFNA(IFS(s"&"core1 > score2, 1, score1 < score2, -1), 0),
      GDdelta, score1 - score2,
      team1NextMD, team1PrevMD + MDdelta,
      team2NextMD, team2PrevMD - MDdelta,
      team1NextGD, team1PrevGD + GDdelta,
      team2NextGD, team2PrevGD - GDdelta,
      BYRO"&"W(table, LAMBDA(tableRow, IF(
        CHOOSECOLS(tableRow, 2)=team1, HSTACK(CHOOSECOLS(tableRow, 1, 2), team1NextMD, team1NextGD),
        IF(CHOOSECOLS(tableRow, 2)=team2, HSTACK(CHOOSECOLS(tableRow, 1, 2), team2NextMD, team2NextGD),
        tableRow
   "&"   ))))
    ))
  ))),
  SORT(standings, 3, FALSE, 4, FALSE)
)"),"")
